source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Create an approved sign-in account and access VA.gov
next_steps: Create a Login.gov or ID.me account.
Sign in to VA.gov.
Verify the personal information associated with the account.
milestones.important_note: Keep account credentials in a secure location.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Gather medical records and prepare for a BDD submission
next_steps: Review BDD eligibility requirements.
List the conditions intended for the claim.
Gather military, VA, private, and civilian medical records.
Schedule needed medical appointments.
milestones.important_note: A BDD claim may still be submitted while documented medical appointments are pending.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Review the draft DD214 for accuracy
next_steps: Verify personal and service information.
Review character of service and discharge information.
Check occupation, training, awards, and separation codes.
Report discrepancies to the appropriate personnel office.
milestones.important_note: Incorrect information may affect access to benefits and can be difficult to correct after separation.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Replace the .mil email address with personal contact information
next_steps: Create a personal email address if needed.
Update the email address on VA.gov.
Update DOD systems that use the .mil address.
Update mailing address and telephone information.
milestones.important_note: Access to the .mil email address generally ends after separation.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Contact a VA Liaison for Healthcare
milestones.source_timing: As soon as eligible to apply for VA health care
next_steps: Locate the appropriate VA health care liaison.
Discuss transfer of health records and prescriptions.
Coordinate registration for VA health care.
Discuss scheduling an initial VA appointment.
milestones.important_note: VA health care liaisons support continuity of care between DOD and VA.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Submit a Benefits Delivery at Discharge claim
next_steps: Complete the Separation Health Assessment self-assessment.
Submit gathered medical and supporting records.
Attend required medical examinations.
Seek accredited assistance when appropriate.
milestones.important_note: A VSO or Military Service Coordinator may be available to assist with the claim.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Review and apply for a VA SkillBridge opportunity
next_steps: Review available SkillBridge opportunities.
Determine applicable program requirements.
Complete the application process.
Obtain command approval.
milestones.important_note: Military branches may impose additional participation requirements.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Apply for Personalized Career Planning and Guidance
next_steps: Review PCPG eligibility information.
Apply online, by mail, or in person.
Prepare to discuss work experience and career goals.
milestones.important_note: The workbook encourages scheduling PCPG before separation when possible.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

next_steps: Gather information needed for the VA health care application.
Apply online or submit VA Form 10-10EZ in person.
Retain application confirmation information.
milestones.important_note: There is no general deadline to apply; the workbook states that an application may be submitted no earlier than one year before separation or any time afterward.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Submit an initial Fully Developed Claim when applicable
milestones.source_timing: 89 days before or any time after separation
next_steps: Complete VA Form 21-526EZ.
Submit available supporting evidence.
Attend scheduled claim examinations.
milestones.important_note: The workbook encourages filing within the pre-separation window for an expedited decision and notes possible backpay when filed within one year after separation.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Engage with VA Solid Start outreach
next_steps: Keep contact information current on VA.gov.
Save the VA Solid Start telephone number.
Respond when VA Solid Start calls.
milestones.important_note: VA Solid Start contacts newly separated Veterans during their first year after separation.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Submit the finalized DD214 for a previously filed BDD claim
next_steps: Obtain the finalized DD214.
Submit the document through the authorized VA process.
Track the claim and respond to document requests.
milestones.important_note: The submitted copy should include separation and character-of-service information.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Submit an FDC or Standard Claim when needed
next_steps: Identify the type of claim to file.
Consider help from a VA-accredited representative.
Gather medical and supporting documents.
Review the official disability compensation guidance.
milestones.important_note: The workbook states there is no deadline to file and describes an Intent to File as a way to preserve a potential effective date.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Review and apply for Veteran Readiness and Employment
next_steps: Review VR&E program information.
Apply online, by mail, or in person.
Consider accredited assistance when needed.
milestones.important_note: VetPath provides program information but does not determine VR&E eligibility.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Access mental health support when needed
milestones.source_timing: 12 months after separation and beyond; support is always available
next_steps: Review available VA mental health services.
Use urgent or crisis support when appropriate.
milestones.important_note: The workbook states that there is no deadline to seek support and directs Veterans in crisis to dial 988 and press 1.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Review and apply for GI Bill benefits
next_steps: Review available VA education benefit programs.
Compare education and training options.
Use the official VA application process.
milestones.important_note: The workbook notes that only one VA education or training benefit may be used at a time.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook

milestones.action: Request a VA home loan Certificate of Eligibility
next_steps: Review VA home-loan eligibility information.
Gather supporting service documentation.
Request a Certificate of Eligibility through an authorized method.
milestones.important_note: VetPath does not determine home-loan eligibility or funding-fee exemptions.
milestones.source_document: VA Benefits and Services Know Before You Go Workbook
